steps.text: Non-stick pan, dry, medium-high. Spinach in (100/120 g) with a pinch of salt. 60 seconds, until it collapses. Tip onto a plate and press the water out with the back of a spoon.
Rapeseed oil into the pan (her 5 g / him 8 g) — it hits a hot base, so it's the pan oil per the D0-003 ruling. Beat the eggs (100 g — 2 eggs) with black pepper. Pour in and tilt to coat the base.
Leave 45 seconds untouched. As the edge sets, draw it to the middle with a spatula and tilt again. Twice more — you want three or four soft folds, not scramble.
Tomato (80/100 g) and tortilla (45/50 g) warmed alongside. Spinach over one half, cheddar on top (15/20 g). Fold, lid on, heat OFF. 60 seconds to melt.
Avocado (35/45 g) sliced onto the tortilla. Fold the egg in. Plate.

why: Wilt and squeeze. Spinach is mostly water and it will steam the eggs into a wet mess otherwise. And take the pan off the heat before the cheese goes on — residual heat melts it and the egg stays tender.
notes: L3 format coverage: spinach uses (100/120 g), egg uses (100 g) [equal], rapeseed_oil uses 'her 5 g / him 8 g', tomato/tortilla/cheddar/avocado use (x/y g).
D0-003 applied: this card's whole oil allowance goes into the pan under the eggs on medium-high heat (no separate dressing/finishing use), so the full 5/8 g becomes rapeseed_oil, not olive_oil.
